passage.label: Indeed We sent Noah people saying warn people before comes painful punishment; he said O my people indeed I am to you clear warner; saying worship Allah fear Him obey me; Allah forgive you sins delay you specified term indeed time set Allah when comes not delayed if only knew

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٌ
يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ

mainSubject.label: Noah sent to his people with the commission to warn them before a painful punishment arrives; his self-declaration as a clear warner followed by the threefold message — worship Allah, fear Him and obey me; the promised outcome being forgiveness of sins and respite for a specified term, sealed by the principle that Allah's appointed time cannot be delayed once it arrives

subordinateSubjects.label: Noah sent to his people with the commission to warn before a painful punishment arrives

Forgiveness of sins and respite for a specified term promised, with Allah's appointed time undelayable once it comes

notes: Wave 10 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the undelayable appointed term (4) before Noah's night-and-day complaint opens (5); P2 ends with the earth-as-expanse and roads-of-passage argument (20) before the disobedience-and-conspiracy report begins (21); P3 runs through the five named idols, the drowning verdict, the no-inhabitant plea and the closing comprehensive supplication (21-28).
